text:
nina: Quick heads-up 12:08 UTC. We're seeing an increase in generation errors (truncated responses / 500s) for model-redwood-7b in eu-west. Holding all product launch social and benchmark posts until we have a clearer picture.

statusbot: [incident] model_inference_errors_eu detected at 12:08 UTC. Alerting on increased 5xx and truncated outputs.

sam: Ops investigating. Initial signal looks like a config mismatch after an autoscaler bump in eu-west-2. Scaling rollback in progress; ETA 20-30m. No customer data exposure.

nina: OK. Marketing: pause all outbound campaign sends and scheduled threads. For the public statuspage, I want a brief "Investigating" blurb that doesn't call out a specific model name but explains degraded generation quality for customers in EU. Draft for quick review:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're investigating reports of degraded generation quality and occasional errors for inference requests in our EU region. Engineers are actively working on mitigation.
Next update: within 30 minutes.
Impact: Some customers in EU may see truncated responses or elevated error rates.``` Thoughts?

lee: Support queue getting pings from a few customers. Suggest adding a note to CS templates: invite customers to share request IDs and well prioritize investigation. Keep tone apologetic but concise.

aaron: Also for benchmark blog thread: pull the planned micro-benchmark that references eu-west numbers. We should avoid publishing any new model performance numbers until status is clear.

sam: Rollback completed 12:25 UTC. Error rate dropped ~80% within 3 minutes; we're running validation across replicas. Recommend a 20m verification window before moving status to "Monitoring."

nina: Sounds good. Can we tighten the status copy to include a "what we're doing" line? Draft update:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're investigating degraded generation quality and intermittent errors affecting inference in the EU region.
What we're doing: Engineers are rolling back a recent scaling config and validating replicas.
Next update: ~20 minutes.
Impact: A subset of inference requests in EU may be truncated or return errors; some retries may help.```

lee: CS template update (short):```Hi — we saw your report and are investigating degraded responses in EU. Please reply with a sample request ID and we'll prioritize. Sorry for the disruption.```

aaron: Marketing action items: 1) Pause blog/benchmark tweet + remove any eu-specific numbers in the draft, 2) Hold webinar invites to EU audiences for 24h, 3) Notify partners privately if they were scheduled for any PR.

nina: Agreed. I'll queue a pause and DM partners. Also proposing we add an FAQ bullet on status explaining retries and how to contact support.

sam: Validation window green at 12:45 UTC. No regressions in the last 10m. Recommend switch to "Monitoring" then to "Resolved" after a further 10m of stability.

nina: Draft monitoring update (to publish now):```Status: Monitoring
Summary: We've mitigated the issue impacting generation quality and error rate in the EU region; systems are under observation.
What we did: Rolled back a recent autoscaling config and validated replicas.
Next update: 10 minutes or earlier.
Impact: Intermittent truncation/errors are expected to be resolved; if you still see issues please contact support with request IDs.```

aaron: Once marked resolved, we should follow with a short post-incident note in the blog/marketing channel explaining the root cause (config autoscaler mismatch) and the mitigation. Also coordinate a delayed benchmark post for non-EU numbers early next week.

lee: Sent CS template to the queue.

sam: Monitoring shows stable at 12:55 UTC. No new errors.

nina: OK publishing resolution at 12:56 UTC then rescheduling paused marketing assets. Resolution draft:```Status: Resolved
Summary: The generation quality and error rate issue in the EU region is resolved. Engineers rolled back a scaling configuration that caused instability and validated replicas.
Timeline: Issue observed 12:08 UTC, mitigation applied 12:25 UTC, validated 12:55 UTC.
Follow-up: Well update with a brief post-incident note describing the autoscaling config issue and steps to prevent recurrence. If you experienced problems, please contact support.```

aaron: Approved. Nina: coordinate the benchmark scheduling and keep EU audiences flagged for +24h hold.

nina: Done. Paused assets and notified PR/partners. I'll post links to the statuspage and CS note in this thread. Closing thread after that. :white_check_mark:
